player_prompt.intro:
Wo reko Mastermind.
Wo hia paako a {code_length} nkyekyem ne mu, nkyekyem biara fi 1 kosi {num_numbers}, {repeats}.
Wo bua mu no, wo betumi de wo nsaanoa wɔ saa format yi: '[2 1 4 5]'.
Akyiri yi bua biara, wo benya feedback wɔ abosode tuntum ne fitaa nkyekyem mu.
Abosode tuntum kyerɛ nkyekyem a ɛyɛ pɛ wɔ pɛ ɔfasuo, bere a abosode fitaa kyerɛ nkyekyem a ɛyɛ pɛ wɔ ɔfasuo a ɛnte pɛ.
Wo wɔ {max_turns} bua paako no.
player_prompt.with_repeats: a wobetumi asan ayɛ no bio
player_prompt.no_duplicates: a wɔnfa mprenu mma mu no bi nni hɔ

invalid_move.wrong_format: Wummua sɛ wode nnumero a wɔde mpaawa apaapae no bɛhyɛ ntweaban mu.
invalid_move.not_integers: Biribiara a w'akyerɛw no wɔ hɔ no, ɛsɛ sɛ ɛyɛ integer a ɛfata.
invalid_move.wrong_length: Ɛsɛ sɛ nea wɔreka no yɛ {code_length} pɛpɛɛpɛ.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ɛsɛ sɛ nnum biara yɛ 1 kosi {num_numbers}.
invalid_move.duplicates_not_allowed: Wɔmma kwan mma wɔnkyerɛw nnumero abien.
invalid_move.repeated_guess: Woadi kan ahu {guess}. Yɛsrɛ wo, bɔ mmɔden sɛ wobɛte ase foforo bi mu.

game_action.feedback: Wo de [{guess}] kɔe. Feedback: {black_pegs} abosode tuntum, {white_pegs} abosode fitaa.

outcome.win: Wo abu paako no, akyerɛw {black_pegs} wɔ {code_length} nkyekyem mu pɛpɛɛpɛ
outcome.turn_limit: W'agya bere a wɔahyɛ no. Woabu {percent} percent wɔ nɔma no mu pɛpɛɛpɛ.
